subject: Kickoff: Dedicated capacity MAP for Klarity — throughput & stakeholders
messages:
From: Jordan Liu <jordan@klarity.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@klarity.ai>
Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity evaluation — MAP kickoff request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineering and product teams were impressed with the latency numbers. We want to kick off a mutual action plan so we can evaluate Redwood Dedicated for our clinical data extraction workload and target an end-of-quarter close.

High-level asks from our side:
- A MAP deck or template we can review
- Initial throughput and cost projection for ~500 concurrent active users, typical request size ~1.2k tokens (avg), P95 latency target < 300ms
- Stakeholder list from Redwood (technical, procurement, CSM) so we can align internal approvers

Would appreciate a short kickoff call next week (30–45m). Sara (cc'd) is our procurement lead — she'll want to be involved on timeline and contract terms.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering
Klarity.ai
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan@klarity.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity evaluation — MAP kickoff request

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks and the call last week. Happy to own the MAP kickoff from our side.

Attached: Klarity_Dedicated_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP template) and throughput_projections_q3_q4.pdf (rough estimates for similar customers).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros & roles (who does what on both sides)
2) Workload profile review (tokens, spike patterns, KV cache expectations)
3) Target throughput & latency commitments for evaluation (what we can demonstrate in a 2-week eval)
4) Evidence & security/compliance asks (SOC2 artifacts, network footprint)
5) Procurement timeline & next steps

From Redwood, I'd like Ben to lead capacity sizing and Karthik to be the primary SRE contact; Monica will cover onboarding and rollout (canary + fallback policies).

Proposed slots:
- Tue 2027-07-20 10:30–11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-07-21 14:00–14:45 PT

If those don't work, tell me a few times and we'll adapt. Jordan / Sara — for throughput, the 500 concurrent active users number is a good start; we’ll come back with a few candidate GPU pool sizes and expected p95s in the MAP.

Cheers,

--
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Klarity_Dedicated_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (workbook), throughput_projections_q3_q4.pdf (summary)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity evaluation — MAP kickoff request

Adding a few notes for the MAP template before we send:
- I'll include a GPU pool mapping appendix with 2 candidate configs: 8x A40-like nodes (cost-optimized, higher batch) and 4x H100-like nodes (latency-optimized).
- For Klarity's profile (1.2k tokens avg), we should design the eval to target ~350–400 qps sustained across the pool — that should allow p95 < 300ms on the H100 config and ~350–420ms on the A40 config depending on batching.
- We need their expected concurrency distribution (steady vs burst) and the percent of long context runs (>4k tokens). That will change KV cache and memory planning.

I'll draft the capacity appendix and drop in the Drive link for Chloe to attach.

Ben
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Liu <jordan@klarity.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara@klarity.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@klarity.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity evaluation — MAP kickoff request

Thanks Chloe & team — Tue 7/20 10:30 PT works for us. Quick answers to the questions above:
- Concurrency: 500 active users with typical fan-out of 1.6 requests/user -> target ~800 concurrent requests in peak windows. Steady-state tends to be ~60% of peak.
- Long context: ~12% of requests are >4k tokens.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II is required, plus a short network diagram for our security review.

Sara (cc) — for procurement timeline: we need an evaluation quote and estimated committed cost for a 3-month reserved capacity trial; we aim to finish procurement by Aug 15.

Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering, Klarity.ai

Perfect — thanks for the numbers, Jordan. Meeting confirmed for Tue 7/20 10:30 PT (Calendar invite sent).

Quick summary of pre-work we will bring to the call (so we can move quickly once we start):
- Ben: GPU pool sizing appendix with two candidate configs + expected p95s for the workload you described.
- Karthik: SRE checklist and test harness for the 2-week eval (what telemetry we'll collect, fallbacks, load patterns).
- Monica & Tessa: Onboarding playbook and canary rollout plan; we'll include a shared runbook for incident handoff.
- Chloe: MAP workbook with milestones and target close date (we'll draft a target close date of 2027-08-12 to keep procurement cadence aligned).

Sara — for procurement, we'll include a trial pricing appendix and a short list of contract items typically required for Dedicated: data isolation language, committed capacity term, and SLA language. If you can share any internal PO process notes or required contract templates prior to the call, that will speed things up.

Action items:
- Redwood: drop the GPU pool appendix to the Drive link and update the MAP workbook before the kickoff (Ben / Chloe)
- Klarity: share any sample requests or a small dataset for the eval agent (anonymized) and PO timeline (Sara)

Looking forward to it.

Best,
